title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
title_zh: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation：无需 Rubric Verifier 的后训练方法
abstract_en: Rubrics have emerged as an alternative to RLVR in open-ended domains where a single ground-truth final answer is not available. Existing rubric-based training methods rely on an LLM verifier that scores each rollout against rubrics. This introduces substantial training-time overhead, exposes optimization to verifier-specific biases, and reduces rubric feedback to a sparse end-of-trajectory signal. We propose Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD), a verifier-free training method in which the base policy, conditioned on the rubric, serves as the teacher for the unconditioned student. RGSD distills the rubric-conditioned teacher distribution into the student token-by-token, replacing sparse trajectory-level rewards with dense per-token learning signals and removing the LLM judge from the training loop entirely. Across Qwen-2.5 (3B, 7B) and Qwen3-Thinking (4B, 8B) models on medical and science domains, RGSD achieves rubric satisfaction comparable to judge-based GRPO while using one on-policy rollout per prompt and no training-time verifier calls. Ablations show that raw rubrics provide a stronger teacher enrichment signal than self-generated reference responses, while a stronger GRPO judge can outperform RGSD in some settings, positioning RGSD as a complementary verifier-free alternative when verifier cost or reliability is the bottleneck.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation（RGSD），一种面向开放式任务的无验证器（verifier-free）后训练方法。现有 rubric-based training 通常依赖 LLM verifier 根据评分细则（rubrics）对每条 rollout 打分，带来高训练开销、verifier 偏置风险，并且只提供稀疏的轨迹级反馈。RGSD 让同一个 base policy 在给定 rubric 条件下充当 teacher，并将其 token-by-token 的分布蒸馏到不带 rubric 条件的 student 中，从而把稀疏终局奖励转化为密集的逐 token 学习信号，同时完全移除训练循环中的 LLM judge。实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5（3B、7B）与 Qwen3-Thinking（4B、8B）在医疗和科学领域的任务，结果显示 RGSD 在 rubric satisfaction 上可达到接近 judge-based GRPO 的表现，同时每个 prompt 只需一次 on-policy rollout，且训练时不调用 verifier。消融实验表明，原始 rubrics 比自生成参考答案能提供更强的 teacher enrichment 信号；但在某些设置下，更强的 GRPO judge 仍可超过 RGSD，说明 RGSD 更适合作为 verifier 成本或可靠性受限时的互补替代方案。
key_points_zh: 提出 Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation（RGSD）：让 rubric-conditioned base policy 作为 teacher，将其输出分布蒸馏给 unconditioned student，无需训练时 LLM verifier。
相比传统 rubric-based training 的轨迹级稀疏打分，RGSD 提供 token-by-token 的密集监督信号，降低优化对 verifier 偏置和打分噪声的依赖。
在 Qwen-2.5（3B、7B）和 Qwen3-Thinking（4B、8B）的医疗与科学任务上，RGSD 的 rubric satisfaction 接近 judge-based GRPO，但每个 prompt 仅需一次 on-policy rollout，且零训练时 verifier 调用。
消融结果显示，直接使用原始 rubrics 作为条件信息，比使用模型自生成参考回答更能增强 teacher 分布。
RGSD 并非在所有情况下都优于强 judge 的 GRPO；当 verifier 成本高、可靠性不足或易引入偏置时，它是更实用的 verifier-free 后训练替代方案。

llm_assessment.comment: A reasonable verifier-free post-training method, but it is mostly generic model training rather than trace-driven agent platform infrastructure.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该方法是有一定价值的无验证器后训练方案，但更多属于通用模型训练而非轨迹驱动的智能体平台基础设施。
